title: Cohomology of a sheaf supported on a finite-presentation closed subspace is power-torsion
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-pushouts.tex (Pushouts of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-pushouts.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Etale-locally reduce to X = Spec(A) affine with finitely generated I = (f_1..f_r); realize Q by a complex of A-modules (derived quasi-coherence + affine comparison); acyclicity of M_f for f ∈ I forces every x ∈ H^p(M) to be killed by powers of the f_i, so I^n kills x with n = sum n_i; flatness of A -> O_x-bar preserves the torsion statement for the stalk.
